# ezghcloud_instance (Resource)

A compute instance. Launch topology changes replace the instance. Existing volumes and interfaces remain independently owned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `network_interfaces` (Attributes List) Ordered launch interfaces; index zero is primary. Omitted firewall_ids uses defaults; [] attaches none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_interfaces))
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.

### Optional

- `bot_id` (String) Canonical bot_ identity attached to the instance; use ezghcloud_bot.example.slug. Updates take effect without restarting.
- `image` (String) Image alias or exact img_ ID. Required unless root_volume.snapshot_id is set. Aliases resolve once for each launch.
- `operation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for each asynchronous operation, for example 30m.
- `root_device` (String) volume or instanceStore.
- `root_volume` (Attributes) Root volume launch settings. Omit with instanceStore. Import cannot recover original launch sizing without configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--root_volume))
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of String)
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Base64 user data, at most 16 KiB decoded. Terraform state stores this value. Unreadable after launch; import cannot recover it.
- `volume_ids` (List of String) Existing independent volumes attached at launch; never deleted on instance termination.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed resource identifier.
- `network_interface_ids` (List of String)
- `operation_id` (String) Most recent operation initiated by this resource; unavailable on import.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resolved_image_id` (String)
- `root_volume_id` (String)
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--network_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_interfaces`

Optional:

- `firewall_ids` (List of String)
- `ipv4` (Boolean)
- `ipv6` (Boolean)
- `network_interface_id` (String)
- `private_ipv4_address` (String)
- `subnet_id` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--root_volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `root_volume`

Optional:

- `iops` (Number)
- `size_gib` (Number)
- `snapshot_id` (String)
- `throughput_mbps` (Number)
- `volume_type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_instance.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
